_comment: Per-region terrain config. Heightmap is a grayscale PNG; pixel 0 maps to height_range_min meters, pixel 255 to height_range_max. world_extent is the side length in meters (square region centered at world_origin). Subdivide controls mesh density (verts per side). Keep in sync with scripts/gen_terrain_heightmap.py defaults. selva_inner: wake-zone basin (Y=-3) surrounded by gentle berm + the colle / dilettoso monte rising to Y=+35 in the -Z direction (~35m total relief above wake-zone floor, the canonical mecca of the Wood).

player_spawn._comment: Player spawn position in world coordinates. X/Z only - Y is sampled from the heightmap at runtime so the player always stands on the ground regardless of heightmap regeneration. The wake-zone (X=0, Z=0) is the canonical Dante 'lost center' spawn: deep wood floor, no clear orientation, the colle visible to the south (-Z).

limbo._comment: Limbo, the First Circle of Hell. Disc shape per the Inferno cosmology — 300m playable radius, rock collar past the disc edge rises to meet the ceiling. y_offset places the disc floor at world Y = -43.13. Acheron + larvae piles + future features come from runtime TerrainModifiers tagged with region_name='limbo'. Descent stair lands at the disc's north rim (Z=-351.15), inset 30m from the rock wall.
limbo._enclosure_comment: Cavern ceiling. Ceiling at Y=-7; disc floor at Y=-43.13 → 36m of headroom (matches the chapel-corridor exit clearance). The rock collar (heightmap pixels past the disc radius) rises to exactly Y=-7 so the disc wall meets the ceiling continuously. Lateral square-edge walls are hidden behind the rock collar but kept for geometric closure. Hole cutouts (descent corridor, future shafts) come from registered StructureFootprints with cuts_ceiling/cuts_wall flags — see crypt_layout::registerChapelTerrainModifiers.
